title: Green Fee-Free Account features
summary: This document lists Green Fee-Free Account key fees and limits: $22.50 monthly maintenance fee waived with $150 minimum daily balance; overdraft fee $0.00; out-of-network and foreign ATM withdrawal fees $0.00 with a $500 daily (24-hour) ATM limit; paper statement fee $0.00; stop payment $25 per item. It also covers linked savings APY boosts: +0.4% with Bronze Savings and +0.35% with Gold Plus Savings.
